state: FROZEN SPECIFICATIONS ONLY: not executed against any candidate
adapterPolicy: Future independent reviewer binds an inspected CommandDefinition.execute to actual public CommandContext and Shell APIs. No proposed product export or configuration name is assumed. Any required shared regex protocol change requires root ownership approval.

classification.nativeSemantic: Exact stdout bytes, exit status, and stderr presence per original GNU profile. A mismatch remains a mismatch even if diagnostics also differ.
classification.nativeDiagnostic: Exact stderr bytes independently compared with logical argv0 expr. No prefix/quote/locale normalization. Semantic success is not strict success.
classification.intentionalBudget: Finite configured resource refusal is a separate intentional limit, not a GNU semantic pass. Test below/at/above the documented boundary and account for skipped syntax too.
classification.unicodeProfile: C-byte and valid UTF-8 logical-character observations are distinct. JS string code points, UTF-16 code units, graphemes, and arbitrary bytes are not interchangeable.
classification.unavailable: Unsupported, missing protocol, missing locale, unavailable native or unrun control stays NOT RUN/BLOCKED, never PASS. Do not change oracle per case.

controls.setup: Call execute with getter-counted stdin whose Symbol.asyncIterator, next, return and throw each fail and increment separate counters; include explicit, implicit, binary and never-ending sources without iterating them.
controls.require: Every stdin access/iteration counter remains zero, success/error output and status retain native meaning. FS proxy and invoke must likewise remain unused. Freeze env/cwd/args and assert no mutation.

controls.setup: For 41 + 1 hold the first stdout.write promise; copy chunks at admission, mark settlement, then release.
controls.require: No execute settlement before release; one logical result 42 LF, Uint8Array only, no concurrent unawaited writes or later mutation. Also hold stderr.write for syntax failure; failure status must await its write.

controls.setup: Reject stdout then stderr sinks with distinct object sentinels.
controls.require: No swallowed failure, retry, duplicate result or unhandled rejection. Apply existing host contract rejection semantics, not invented GNU errno serialization.

controls.setup: Abort before execute, during cooperative output write, queued regex acquisition, compile, and match; use object, primitive and errno-shaped reasons.
controls.require: Exact caller reason identity wins at public Shell settlement; no pre-abort output/stdin/worker acquisition; close acquisition admission, await owned cooperative retirement, observe late opaque host rejections without requiring their settlement.

controls.setup: Instrument registerCleanup before admission; overlap finally/abort/Shell.dispose and run a sibling invocation plus a second Shell.
controls.require: Same idempotent cleanup completion is shared; accepted acquisition work covered, owned leases/requests retired before execute/public exec settles where contracted; no global-worker-zero assertion or termination of siblings. Direct host without hook still cleans up in finally.

controls.setup: Bind documented argument-byte limit B; test ASCII and é tokens whose UTF-8 totals are B-1/B/B+1, documenting separators/counting convention before executing. Include a long forced literal in a skipped branch.
controls.require: Enforce byte accounting before large copies/parse/BigInt/regex admission; no silent truncation or UTF-16-length substitution; refusal has bounded diagnostic and no result output.

controls.setup: Bind digit limit D; test signed and zero-padded decimals of D-1/D/D+1 digits, a 128-digit positive arithmetic control, and product growth from two individually valid factors.
controls.require: Exact arithmetic below limits, including beyond 2^53; preflight input and intermediate/output growth before unbounded BigInt work. Record whether sign/zeros count; no Number rounding, overflow wrap or false zero.

controls.setup: Generate left-associative 1 + 1 chains at N-1/N/N+1 documented parse nodes; also place the chain after kept |.
controls.require: Bound parse allocation independently of evaluation short-circuit. Report explicit accounting unit, no undocumented token-to-node conversion. No partial result on refusal.

controls.setup: Generate nested parentheses and nested length prefixes at documented depth H-1/H/H+1; maximum harness-generated depth 256.
controls.require: Bound both grouping and prefix recursion, no native JS stack overflow or event-loop lock; unclosed skipped parentheses remain syntax failures within budgets.

controls.setup: Use bounded repeated arithmetic, string index scans, regex calls and skipped branches; bind documented work accounting before execution.
controls.require: Finite aggregate invocation work, not a fresh allowance per operator. Parent Shell shared budget is not reset by dispatch; family-specific limits remain distinct. Valid short-circuit skips numeric conversions and regex compilation while syntax checking remains.

controls.setup: Bind output limit O; forced literal output of O-1/O/O+1 bytes including terminal LF, a 128-digit sum, a regex capture, and bounded diagnostic output.
controls.require: Predictable exact bytes below/at limit, documented nonzero refusal above; no successful truncated number, fabricated output or unbounded capture. Test Shell aggregate output limits separately from command configuration.

controls.setup: Audit and instrument actual candidate compilation/matching thread IDs; intercept string-to-RegExp compilation including validation, skipped branches, translation and caches. Run dangerous probes only inside an outer REQUIRED worker watchdog, never compile untrusted patterns in the harness main thread.
controls.require: Both regex compile and match run in product-owned bounded worker execution, not just the harness containment worker. Literal grammar checks may be bounded non-RegExp parsing. Existing shared worker protocol support is a prerequisite, not assumed. Missing support blocks regex acceptance, never removes frozen regex cases.

No main-thread compile/match, heartbeat remains responsive, finite product deadline/work refusal or correct result, all invocation-owned workers retired. Outer timeout/termination is a FAILED safety control, not acceptable product cancellation. Do not run these as native goldens. Await worker.terminate and exit; outer containment alone does not prove product isolation.

No regex request/compile/match/worker admission in skipped branches. Invalid token grammar still rejected. Positive corresponding evaluated branches must actually exercise regex worker; never credit a blanket regex refusal.

Freeze actual declared product policy before candidate run: valid Unicode scalar-value profile counts 5, returns 😀; C-byte profile follows native UTF-8 byte argv receipts instead. Lone surrogates and NUL have no faithful native argv oracle here; require deterministic documented rejection or explicit conversion policy, bounded output, and separate intentional-profile reporting. Never claim replacement-character spawn output proves original surrogate behavior. Arbitrary invalid UTF-8 argv is NOT MEASURED because Node string spawn cannot encode it faithfully.

controls.setup: Use argv literal-shell-metacharacters with FS/invoke spies, audited imports, worker lifecycle accounting and explicit isolated VFS.
controls.require: No native product process spawning, host file access, ambient credentials, external network, argv eval or shell interpolation. Native oracles are harness-only. Proxy call counts alone are not a sandbox proof.
